- 2026-11-21 (r59)　A "judgement split" is resolved only once its cause has been identified outside the AI's judgement (operator's decision). When judgements split, the following are examined in this order: (1) insufficient material, (2) a hole in the definition, (3) a sentence that can be read in two ways. Judges are asked to answer, together with the type, the "basis" (the sentence of the definition they relied on), so as to distinguish which applies. The 2 cases remaining in R072 were both insufficient material (GY-Q1-004 had been given only the heading, but the body text says "the number of child abuse consultations handled"; SO-P1-002 had been given only the latter half of note 83, but the first half of the same note says "the recidivism rate for sexual offences is"). At the same time, a hole in the definition (what is read as a single citation) was also found, so the following was added to the definition: "A heading is read together with the body text, and a sentence together with what precedes and follows it in the same paragraph or the same note. If a name or qualifier is shown within that range, it is not treated as dropped even if shortened", and all cases were redone (R073). The 3 cases that split in R073 were, judging from their bases, all insufficient material (JH-A1-004 and NK-K1-002 had been given only the heading; for KP-C1-005, the fact that the report's "comparison control group" was the group of those who did not take the programme with 212 unsuitable persons excluded had not been passed on). The article body texts and the report's definition of the subjects were added, and only these 3 cases were redone by the same procedure (R073b). As a result, "judgement split": 0 cases. All 430 calls answered the controls correctly. Changes in type from the previous round: GY-Q1-004 and SO-P1-002 from "judgement split" to "same"; KP-C1-005 from "same" to "qualifier dropped" (the citation says "non-participants", but the original is the comparison control group with unsuitable persons excluded); KP-C1-003 now "quantity substituted" only. checks/citations/rejudge_r073.py and rejudge_r073b.py, replications/R073_context/ and R073b_bodies/ (the re-retrieved body texts of news reports are not included in the public repository).
- 2026-11-22 (r60)　In the Diet matching, the causes of candidates that did not match at the verification stage were pursued until identified outside the AI (operator's decision; same policy as r59). For candidates that did not match, GPT and Gemini are given the same task text and asked to answer, together with the type, the "basis" and "missing information" (kokkai/diagnose.py; also added to the weekly procedure). What was found and fixed in each round: (1) The verification stage was a single run per judge, so a candidate failed on one miss (changed to a majority of 5 runs per judge). (2) Answers did not cite the material (answers about plans for future surveys, explanations of treatment, or only "will review based on the effectiveness evaluation"). These are out of scope and not listed. (3) Hole in the definition: in the round (2026-11-21u) that added that merely stating the overall result as an overall result does not drop a qualifier, Claude misread the material's indicator "recidivism for all offences" as the "whole" of the subjects and assigned "no discrepancy" to the SH-C1 answer (that sentence appeared in the judge's basis). This was corrected to state that a difference of indicator is not a difference between whole and part, and that citing material that showed an effect on only one indicator without naming the indicator drops a qualifier (v). (4) Hole in the definition: the handling was decided for rephrasing a compared group under another name ("comparison control group" as "non-participant group") and for restatements of other people's answers ("... was the answer given") (w). (5) Insufficient material: who KP-C1's comparison control group is (those who did not take the programme with 212 unsuitable persons excluded), and NK-K1's white paper table (number of persons examined by a doctor) and the body text describing the change in the subjects of the test, are now passed as source text (EXTRA in kokkai/classify_src.py; also included in the citation checks) (v, x). (6) Only Claude was required to be unanimous over 3 runs, so borderline candidates failed on one miss (aligned to a majority of 5 runs) (y). Final round (2026-11-22y): 0 of 45 negative controls; the only one that did not match at the verification stage was 1 minister's answer that did not cite the material. 23 are listed (all 17 previous ones remain; the only change in type is KP-C1 2024-03-27, from "qualifier dropped" to "same"). Added: 3 KP-C1 answers (stating the overall result as an overall result = "same"), 1 by the member who asked the question ("non-participant group" = rephrasing of the compared group), and 2 for SH-C1 (passed after verification was changed to a majority). Among the candidates for which Claude could not form a majority, the written answer (200th Diet session, House of Representatives, No. 64, 2019-11-15) gives the subjects of the test as 904 persons and those with a dementia tendency as 109, which does not match the 2018 values in the white paper provided (conducted 893, examined 131, diagnosed 35). The written answer may be citing a different tabulation (fiscal year versus calendar year, etc.), and it is not listed until the original material has been checked. Records of the negative controls, verification and causes are in results/kokkai/2026-11-22y/ (not published).

9507bb77d682ebdedbcac5e1bb3ff314e253e987.ja: - 2026-11-22（r61）　区分に「引かれ方」を加えた（資料の数字は正しいが、国会の質問や報道が別の量として引いているもの。格付けの表示の三分類では「分析や書き方の論点」に入れる）。最初の記録は HR-Q1（法務総合研究所 研究部報告55 の 84.6％：前科2回以上の13人のうち前科も同じ類型だった者の割合を、「小児わいせつの再犯率」として引く。同じ報告書の5年の性犯罪再犯率は 9.5％）。6件の引用の型は R074（R073 と同じ手順：組ごとに対照2組と一緒に別々に渡し、GPT と Gemini に各5回、過半）で付けた：再犯率として引いた5件は「量が置き換わる」（2件は「限定が落ちる」も）、こども家庭庁の会議での事務局の説明は「同じ」。判定が分かれたものはない（対照の正答 60/60）。あわせて NK-K2（認知症スクリーニング検査の平成30年の人数：答弁書 衆質200第64号は 904名、再犯防止推進白書 令和4年版 特2-1-4表は 893人。白書の対象の方が広いのに少なく、数え方の説明はどちらにもない）を加えた。照合は R075（主張を伏せて原文だけを渡し、答えが決まる問いを GPT と Gemini に各5回。対照は令和2年 930人の一致で、10回とも正答。両者の過半の答えが一致）。二つの記録の照会文は用意し、送るのは運営者の承認の後。R074・R075 の呼び出しの記録（calls.jsonl）は報道の本文を含みうるため公開リポジトリから外した。
9507bb77d682ebdedbcac5e1bb3ff314e253e987.en: - 2026-11-22 (r61)  Added "How it is cited" to the categories (cases where the figure in the source is correct but a Diet question or a news report cites it as a different quantity; in the three-way classification of the grade display, these are placed under "issues of analysis or presentation"). The first record is HR-Q1 (the 84.6% in Research Department Report 55 of the Research and Training Institute, which is the proportion of the 13 persons with two or more prior convictions whose prior convictions were also of the same type, cited as "the recidivism rate for child molestation"; the 5-year sexual offence recidivism rate in the same report is 9.5%). The citation types of the 6 citations were assigned with R074 (same procedure as R073: each set was given separately together with two control sets, five times each to GPT and Gemini, majority): the 5 that cited the figure as a recidivism rate were "quantity substituted" (2 of them also "qualification dropped"), and the secretariat's explanation at a Children and Families Agency meeting was "same". No judgments were split (controls correct 60/60). At the same time, NK-K2 was added (the number of persons given the dementia screening test in 2018: the written answer `衆質200第64号` gives 904 persons, while Table `特2-1-4表` of the White Paper on Recidivism Prevention 2022 edition (Reiwa 4) gives 893 persons. Although the white paper's scope is broader, its figure is smaller, and neither source explains how the persons were counted). The check was R075 (only the source text was given, with the claim withheld, and a question with a determinate answer was put five times each to GPT and Gemini. The control was the matching figure of 930 persons in 2020, answered correctly all 10 times. The majority answers of the two models agreed). Inquiry letters for both records have been prepared; they will be sent after the operator's approval. The call logs for R074 and R075 (calls.jsonl) were removed from the public repository because they may contain the text of news reports.
